title: Logan Howlett
description: Logan is a nearly immortal mutant with rapid healing and adamantium-laced claws, forged by decades of black-ops experimentation and personal loss into the X-Men's most reluctant hero. He fights alongside Xavier's students across four decades before a slow-acting poison finally catches up to him in 2029, where he sacrifices himself protecting a new generation of mutants. His long memory ties together Fox's fractured X-Men timeline more than any other character.

title: Bucky Barnes
description: Bucky Barnes is Steve Rogers's childhood friend, presumed dead in World War II before being rebuilt by HYDRA as the brainwashed assassin the Winter Soldier. Freed from mind control, he spent years atoning for his crimes alongside Sam Wilson and later took a seat in the U.S. Congress.

title: Steve Rogers
description: Steve Rogers is a World War II super soldier who spent decades frozen in ice before waking into the modern world and leading the Avengers. Unwavering and idealistic, he fought alongside the team through Ultron, the Winter Soldier crisis, and Thanos's invasion, before using time travel to live out a full life and returning his shield to Sam Wilson.
metaDescription: Steve Rogers is a World War II super soldier who spent decades frozen in ice before waking into the modern world and leading the Avengers.

title: Raven Darkhölme
description: Raven Darkhölme is a shapeshifting mutant raised alongside Charles Xavier who becomes a reluctant symbol for mutant liberation after a very public act of heroism in 1973. Torn between Xavier's ideals and Erik's militancy, she spends the next two decades as one of the mutant community's most visible and most hunted figures. She is killed in 1992 during a rescue mission gone wrong, a death that sends the X-Men down a darker path.

title: Hank McCoy
description: Hank McCoy is a brilliant scientist and mutant whose feline strength and agility come with a physical transformation he spends years trying to suppress. A founding member of Xavier's school, he serves as the X-Men's moral conscience through its earliest and most turbulent decades and, later, as a government liaison for mutant affairs. He remains one of Xavier's most steadfast allies through the fallout of the 1990s.
metaDescription: Hank McCoy is a brilliant scientist and mutant whose feline strength and agility come with a physical transformation he spends years trying to suppress.

title: Erik Lehnsherr
description: Erik Lehnsherr is a Holocaust survivor turned master of magnetism, his childhood trauma convincing him that mutants must dominate rather than coexist with humanity. He alternates between ally and adversary of Charles Xavier across decades of mutant history, founding and leading the Brotherhood of Mutants through the school's most dangerous years. His fate after the mid-2000s is left open in the films that carry his old friend's story forward to its end.

title: Charles Xavier
description: Charles Xavier is the telepathic founder of the school for gifted mutants, spending decades trying to build peaceful coexistence between mutants and humanity. His friendship-turned-rivalry with Erik Lehnsherr shapes nearly every major X-Men conflict from the 1960s onward, and the same time-travel event that rewrites their future keeps him at the center of it into old age. He dies in 2029, his final seizure setting off the chain of events that defines Logan's last stand.

title: Peter Maximoff
description: Peter Maximoff is a mutant with extreme superspeed who treats his powers, and most consequences, like a joke, much to Xavier's exasperation. His mother's history with Erik Lehnsherr, a secret even to him for years, puts him at the edge of several major X-Men conflicts from the 1970s through the 90s. He never loses his easygoing streak, even as the stakes around him escalate.
metaDescription: Peter Maximoff is a mutant with extreme superspeed who treats his powers, and most consequences, like a joke, much to Xavier's exasperation.

title: Kurt Wagner
description: Kurt Wagner is a teleporting, blue-skinned mutant raised in a German circus before Xavier recruits him to the school in the 1980s. His faith and gentle nature stand in sharp contrast to his intimidating appearance and the violence he's repeatedly drawn into. He remains one of Xavier's most loyal students through the Phoenix crisis of 1992.
metaDescription: Kurt Wagner is a teleporting, blue-skinned mutant raised in a German circus before Xavier recruits him to the school in the 1980s.

title: Ororo Munroe
description: Ororo Munroe is a mutant who can summon and control weather on a massive scale, discovered as a gifted young thief before Xavier brings her into the fold. She grows into one of the X-Men's most powerful and composed members through the turbulent 1980s and 90s. Her calm command of her abilities makes her a natural leader in the field.
metaDescription: Ororo Munroe is a mutant who can summon and control weather on a massive scale, discovered as a gifted young thief before Xavier brings her into the fold.

title: Scott Summers
description: Scott Summers is a mutant whose eyes fire uncontrolled blasts of concussive force, contained only by the ruby-quartz visor Xavier gives him after finding him as a traumatized teenager. He becomes one of the X-Men's most disciplined field leaders and Jean Grey's closest companion. He survives the Phoenix crisis of 1992, though visibly changed by it.

title: Jean Grey
description: Jean Grey is an immensely powerful telepath and telekinetic recruited to Xavier's school as a teenager, her raw potential always shadowed by the danger of losing control. When her abilities fully awaken as the cosmic Phoenix Force, the resulting spiral of grief and power consumes her. She dies in 1992, a tragedy that fractures the X-Men she grew up alongside.

title: Carol Danvers
description: Carol Danvers is a former Air Force pilot whose DNA was fused with a Kree Supreme Intelligence core, granting her near-limitless photon energy powers under the name Captain Marvel. She spent years protecting distant worlds before returning to Earth to help finish the fight against Thanos and, later, to unravel a conspiracy tangled with her own powers.

title: Nick Fury
description: Nick Fury is the one-eyed spymaster who built S.H.I.E.L.D. into a global defense network and personally recruited the Avengers Initiative. He lost his eye to a Kree agent's claws while working alongside a young Carol Danvers, and has spent decades since operating in the shadows, most recently investigating a Skrull infiltration from orbit.
metaDescription: Nick Fury is the one-eyed spymaster who built S.H.I.E.L.D. into a global defense network and personally recruited the Avengers Initiative.

title: Blade
description: Blade is a half-vampire, half-human 'daywalker' who inherited a vampire's strength and healing along with immunity to its weaknesses, and has spent his life hunting the undead to avenge his mother's death. Armed with a silver sword and an arsenal of engineered weapons, he wages a one-man war against vampire bloodlines seeking to enslave humanity.

title: Rogue
description: Rogue is a mutant who absorbs the memories, life force, and abilities of anyone she touches skin-to-skin, a power she can't turn off. Taken in by Xavier's school as a runaway teenager, she becomes central to the X-Men's early battles against the Brotherhood and Weapon X-related threats. She ultimately chooses to give up her powers rather than live without human touch.
metaDescription: Rogue is a mutant who absorbs the memories, life force, and abilities of anyone she touches skin-to-skin, a power she can't turn off.

title: Norman Osborn
description: Norman Osborn is the ruthless head of Oscorp Industries whose experimental performance-enhancing formula drives him insane, transforming him into the murderous Green Goblin. His attacks on Spider-Man end in his own death, impaled on his glider during their final battle over New York.

title: Harry Osborn
description: Harry Osborn is Peter Parker's best friend and the son of industrialist Norman Osborn, whose inherited rage and Oscorp technology eventually turn him into the second Green Goblin. After learning the truth about his father's death and Spider-Man's identity, he sacrifices himself saving Peter and Mary Jane from Venom and Sandman.

title: Mary Jane Watson
description: Mary Jane Watson is Peter Parker's childhood neighbor and on-again, off-again love interest, an aspiring actress who becomes a frequent target of the villains stalking Spider-Man. Her relationship with Peter anchors all three films, culminating in a fragile reconciliation after his battle with Sandman and Venom.

title: Peter Parker (Raimi)
description: Peter Parker is a shy Queens teenager bitten by a genetically-altered spider, gaining wall-crawling strength and reflexes he uses to protect New York as Spider-Man. Guided by his uncle's dying words that with great power comes great responsibility, he balances a photography job at the Daily Bugle with a secret war against the Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, and his own inner darkness.

title: Bruce Banner (Pre-MCU)
description: Bruce Banner is a genetics researcher whose botched gamma radiation experiment, compounded by his father's earlier tampering with his DNA, transforms him into the Hulk, a towering, near-unstoppable green rage monster whenever his adrenaline spikes. Hunted by the military and haunted by fractured memories of his childhood, he struggles to control the creature inside him.

title: Otto Octavius
description: Otto Octavius is a brilliant physicist whose fusion energy experiment goes catastrophically wrong, fusing four mechanical arms to his spine and corrupting his mind into the villainous Doctor Octopus. He ultimately regains his senses and sacrifices himself, drowning his own reactor beneath the East River to save the city.

title: Ben Grimm
description: Ben Grimm is the Fantastic Four's pilot, transformed by cosmic radiation into a hulking, rock-skinned powerhouse he never asked to become. Self-conscious about his new appearance, he channels his frustration into being the team's most dependable heavy hitter. His friendship with Johnny Storm provides much of the team's comic relief.

title: Johnny Storm
description: Johnny Storm is Sue's younger brother, a reckless thrill-seeker whose cosmic exposure lets him burst into flame and fly at will. He's the most eager of the Fantastic Four to embrace fame and his new powers, often to the team's frustration. His rivalry-turned-friendship with Ben Grimm is one of the team's most enduring dynamics.

title: Susan Storm
description: Susan Storm gains the ability to turn invisible and generate protective force fields after the same cosmic radiation exposure that transforms her teammates. A former colleague of Victor Von Doom and Reed Richards's on-again-off-again fiancée, she frequently ends up holding the team together, literally and otherwise. She becomes the Fantastic Four's most level-headed strategist under pressure.

title: Reed Richards (Fox FF)
description: Reed Richards is a brilliant but socially awkward scientist whose experimental space mission exposes him and his crew to cosmic radiation, stretching his body into a nearly limitless elastic form. He leads the newly-formed Fantastic Four in learning to control their powers while facing off against a rival scientist gone wrong. His relationship with Sue Storm anchors the team through its early, chaotic years.

title: Johnny Blaze
description: Johnny Blaze is a motorcycle stunt rider who sold his soul to the demon Mephistopheles to save his father's life, and is periodically transformed into the Ghost Rider, a flaming-skulled Spirit of Vengeance who punishes the guilty with his Penance Stare. He struggles to control the curse while keeping the people he loves out of its reach.

title: Tony Stark
description: Tony Stark is a billionaire engineer who built the first Iron Man armor to escape captivity, then kept building better ones to protect the world as a founding member of the Avengers. His genius powered the team's technology for over a decade, and he ultimately gave his life to defeat Thanos and undo the Blip.

title: Loki
description: Loki is Thor's adopted brother, a Frost Giant raised as an Asgardian prince whose ambition and resentment repeatedly set him against the Avengers before a fragile reconciliation with his brother. He was killed by Thanos aboard the Statesman while trying to protect Thor, though a variant of him escaped into a diverging timeline during the Avengers' 2012 time heist.

title: Thor
description: Thor is the Asgardian God of Thunder, heir to Odin's throne, who learned humility on Earth before losing his home, his brother, and half his people to Thanos. He remains one of the universe's mightiest warriors, wielding Stormbreaker alongside the Guardians of the Galaxy and, later, Zeus's thunderbolt against new threats.

title: Gwen Stacy
description: Gwen Stacy is Peter Parker's brilliant classmate and girlfriend, a fellow science student who assists him against the Lizard and later Oscorp's escaped experiments. She falls to her death during Spider-Man's battle with the Green Goblin, a loss that haunts him for the rest of the franchise.

description: Peter Parker is a science-minded Queens teenager who investigates his late father's research at Oscorp, gets bitten by a genetically engineered spider, and becomes Spider-Man to fight crime and confront the Lizard. title: Natasha Romanoff
description: Natasha Romanoff is a former Russian spy turned S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and founding Avenger, known for her espionage skills and quiet loyalty to her adopted family of heroes. She sacrificed herself on Vormir so the team could retrieve the Soul Stone and reverse the Blip.

title: Clint Barton
description: Clint Barton is a S.H.I.E.L.D. marksman and founding Avenger who lost his family to the Blip and became the vigilante Ronin during the five years Thanos's snap erased half of all life. He later mentored Kate Bishop while hunting down loose ends from his time as Ronin.

title: Max Dillon
description: Max Dillon is an overlooked Oscorp electrical engineer whose obsessive admiration for Spider-Man turns to fury after an accident bathes him in electric eels and leaves him able to generate and control electricity. As Electro, he becomes one of Spider-Man's most destructive foes before Oscorp's own experiments spiral further out of control.

title: Sam Wilson
description: Sam Wilson is a former Air Force pararescueman turned Avenger who fights with a mechanical wingsuit as the Falcon. After Steve Rogers chose to live out his life in the past, he entrusted Sam with the shield, and Sam took up the mantle of Captain America.

title: Rocket
description: Rocket is a genetically and cybernetically engineered creature built from a small mammal through cruel experimentation, channeling his trauma into sharp sarcasm and weapons expertise. He fought to free every other test subject from his creator's lab and stepped up to lead the Guardians of the Galaxy afterward.

title: Nebula
description: Nebula is Gamora's cybernetically-rebuilt adoptive sister, tortured and rebuilt by Thanos after every loss to her in combat until barely anything organic remained. She broke from her father to join the Guardians of the Galaxy and played a key role in the Avengers' time heist against her past self.

title: Gamora
description: Gamora is the last of her kind from a massacred Zehoberei village, adopted and trained as a weapon by Thanos before turning against him to join the Guardians of the Galaxy. The version of her from 2014 was pulled forward in time by Thanos and, after his defeat, chose to stay in the present with the Guardians despite having no memory of her old life with them.

title: Peter Quill
description: Peter Quill was abducted from Earth as a child and raised among space pirates, eventually leading the Guardians of the Galaxy on a mission to protect the cosmos. His half-Celestial heritage gives him latent abilities he rarely relies on, preferring a well-timed quip and an old mixtape instead.

title: Luke Cage
description: Luke Cage is a former convict turned unbreakable, superhumanly strong protector of Harlem after an experimental procedure in prison left his skin bulletproof. Operating first as hired muscle and later as a neighborhood hero, he becomes a symbol of resilience for the community he refuses to abandon.

title: Vision
description: Vision is a synthetic being born from Ultron's body, JARVIS's consciousness, and the Mind Stone, brought to life by Tony Stark and Bruce Banner. He fell in love with Wanda Maximoff and was ultimately destroyed by Thanos, who tore the Mind Stone from his forehead moments after Wanda's own attempt to spare him from that fate.
metaDescription: Vision is a synthetic being born from Ultron's body, JARVIS's consciousness, and the Mind Stone, brought to life by Tony Stark and Bruce Banner.

title: Frank Castle
description: Frank Castle is a former Marine whose family was murdered in a mob crossfire, driving him to become the Punisher, a one-man army who metes out lethal justice to criminals the courts can't touch. His war widens from street gangs to the corrupt operators who covered up his family's death.

title: Jessica Jones
description: Jessica Jones is a hard-drinking, short-tempered private investigator in Hell's Kitchen whose superhuman strength and durability came from a botched military experiment. Haunted by her trauma at the hands of the mind-controlling Kilgrave, she reluctantly uses her abilities to help others while running Alias Investigations.

title: Thanos
description: Thanos is the Titan warlord obsessed with the belief that erasing half of all life in the universe would save it from resource collapse, a philosophy he pursued for decades before finally gathering all six Infinity Stones. He was beheaded by Thor moments after achieving his goal, and a past version of himself pulled forward in time was later disintegrated by the combined Avengers using his own stones.

title: Wanda Maximoff
description: Wanda Maximoff is a reality-warping Avenger whose chaos magic grew from a HYDRA experiment into one of the most powerful forces on Earth. After losing Vision in the fight against Thanos, her grief reshaped an entire town in Westview, and she later resurfaced as the Scarlet Witch in a battle over the Darkhold's power.

title: Wilson Fisk
description: Wilson Fisk is the outwardly respectable businessman known in the shadows as the Kingpin, a criminal mastermind whose imposing size and iron will let him strangle Hell's Kitchen's underworld into a single, personal empire. Repeatedly imprisoned and repeatedly returning, he eventually leverages his ambitions all the way to elected office in New York City.

description: Matt Murdock is a blind Hell's Kitchen attorney whose heightened senses, a legacy of the accident that cost him his sight, let him prowl the city's rooftops as the vigilante Daredevil. By day he practices law with Foggy Nelson; by night he wages a brutal one-man war on the crime lords who run his neighborhood, above all Wilson Fisk.

title: Scott Lang
description: Scott Lang is a reformed cat burglar who dons Hank Pym's subatomic Ant-Man suit to shrink to insect size and, when needed, grow to giant proportions. Trapped in the Quantum Realm during the Blip, his escape gave the Avengers the key to time travel and ultimately to undoing Thanos's snap.
metaDescription: Scott Lang is a reformed cat burglar who dons Hank Pym's subatomic Ant-Man suit to shrink to insect size and, when needed, grow to giant proportions.

description: Peter Parker is a Queens teenager bitten by a genetically altered spider, gaining wall-crawling strength and a danger-sensing "spider-sense" that he uses as the friendly neighborhood Spider-Man. Mentored by Tony Stark and later devastated by a spell gone wrong, he made the world forget he ever existed to protect the people he loves.

title: Wade Wilson
description: Wade Wilson is a mercenary turned into a disfigured, regenerating anti-hero by an experimental program that made him functionally impossible to kill. He breaks the fourth wall as often as he breaks bones, running his own gleefully violent brand of vigilante justice alongside, and occasionally colliding with, the X-Men. Decades later he drags a reluctant Wolverine into a multiverse-hopping buddy story of his own making.
metaDescription: Wade Wilson is a mercenary turned into a disfigured, regenerating anti-hero by an experimental program that made him functionally impossible to kill.

title: T'Challa
description: T'Challa is the King of Wakanda and the Black Panther, protector of a secretive nation built on vibranium technology far beyond the rest of the world. He led Wakanda's forces against Thanos's army and later opened his country to the world, before succumbing to an unspecified illness that Wakanda's own science could not cure.
metaDescription: T'Challa is the King of Wakanda and the Black Panther, protector of a secretive nation built on vibranium technology far beyond the rest of the world.

title: Danny Rand
description: Danny Rand is the heir to a New York fortune who, after surviving a plane crash as a child, was raised by the monks of the mystical city of K'un-Lun and trained to become its Immortal Iron Fist. Wielding a chi-charged fist capable of shattering steel, he returns to reclaim his family's company and defend it from the Hand.

title: Stephen Strange
description: Stephen Strange was a brilliant but arrogant surgeon whose hands were ruined in a car accident, sending him to Kathmandu to seek healing and finding the mystic arts instead. As Sorcerer Supreme, he guards Earth's reality from magical threats and has personally seen millions of possible futures play out.
